findings.title: AGENTS.md migration range is stale (0056 vs head 0057)
findings.impact: A developer/agent following AGENTS.md can mis-state the schema head and miss the newest migration.
findings.recommendation: Update the range (or reference the directory/manifest) so the head is not duplicated in prose.

report: Docs: README constitution, AGENTS.md working contract, runbooks, API reference and product docs are present and cross-linked. Residual: AGENTS.md still states the migration range as 0001-0056 while the head is 0057.
